import struct, zlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('<ACCOUNT_HOME>/.codex/generated_images/01a0f5b8-6cfb-7d53-92eb-5b569d244b59/exec-91072218-961b-41f2-bd62-df93000c57c9.png').read_bytes()
i=8; data=b''
while i<len(p):
 n=struct.unpack('>I',p[i:i+4])[0]; t=p[i+4:i+8]; v=p[i+8:i+8+n]; i+=n+12
 if t==b'IHDR': w,h,depth,kind,_,_,inter=struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',v)
 if t==b'IDAT': data+=v
assert depth==8 and kind in (2,6) and inter==0
c=3 if kind==2 else 4
raw=zlib.decompress(data); rows=[]; prev=bytearray(w*c); pos=0
def paeth(a,b,c):
 p=a+b-c; x=abs(p-a); y=abs(p-b); z=abs(p-c)
 return a if x<=y and x<=z else b if y<=z else c
for y in range(h):
 f=raw[pos]; pos+=1; row=bytearray(raw[pos:pos+w*c]); pos+=w*c
 for x in range(w*c):
  a=row[x-c] if x>=c else 0; b=prev[x]; d=prev[x-c] if x>=c else 0
  row[x]=(row[x]+(0 if f==0 else a if f==1 else b if f==2 else (a+b)//2 if f==3 else paeth(a,b,d)))&255
 rows.append(row); prev=row
out=bytearray()
for y in range(256):
 out.append(0)
 for x in range(256):
  sx=min(w-1,int((x+.5)*w/256)); sy=min(h-1,int((y+.5)*h/256))
  out.extend(rows[sy][sx*c:sx*c+c])
def chunk(t,v):
 return struct.pack('>I',len(v))+t+v+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+v)&0xffffffff)
dest=Path('<WORK>/red-circle-256.png')
dest.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',256,256,8,kind,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(out))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))
print('Saved 256 × 256 PNG')
